items.q: Does this work for my business too?
items.a: If you are a local service business (painter, electrician, plumber, cleaner, glazier, junk removal, locksmith, roofer) yes. We check this in the first call in 5 minutes.
Owners of local service businesses who want more paying customers without doing the marketing themselves. You just need to handle the jobs.

items.q: Do you only make creatives or also strategy?
items.a: Both. Ads, website, Google Business Profile, audiences, budget, reporting. Full performance setup, not only pretty images.

items.q: Do you also run the ads (media buying)?
items.a: Yes. Google Ads, optional Facebook and Instagram (Black Diamond). You do not need to click anything yourself.
1. First call · 2. Onboarding call (60 min) · 3. We build ads and website · 4. Ads go live · 5. Weekly performance report. You just need to show up.

items.q: Do I have to do a call?
items.a: Yes, a short one. 30 minutes. We see if we fit. No sales pressure, no slides.
Gold €3,000 per month, Black Diamond €5,000 per month. Plus your Google Ads budget (paid directly to Google). 3 month minimum, then monthly.
No. Right now we only take local service businesses, and only if we believe we can deliver results. Not every niche, not every city.
